full_details: Nine hours in a bed at the Bell, the soundest since Stratford. Then the mile and a half with the pack, for the look of it. Mistress Ansell met you with a basket of washing, and only after that the letters under Gib, the hour of dinner, and a dry word on the road on your shoes. The coffer, two locks: twenty pound eight shillings as left, seven shillings out of the belt, twenty pound fifteen shillings ruled off. At dinner she had the journey as a plot. Fire, walk, barn, back. You have seen a house you mean to buy. With what? That is the fourth act. The loaf is still a thumb short of the notch. Verbeke says the looms are quiet and nobody has shouted at him since Lammas. Gib is on the cloth on the Holinshed, and has been since July. You did not take the book back. At the Theatre in the afternoon the yard smelled of size and new paint. James has had the posts done over like marble and the heavens blue. Behind the arras Garnish had the king's parts in rolls, tied and named, and the plot ruled on its pasteboard. He gave you Gaunt's roll, your own lines in another man's fair secretary, and six weeks to get them by heart. The king's roll would reach from here to the Curtain, and Burbage had it on Monday. In the evening Burbage, from Holywell. The marshal's men are off the gates. The Rose opens Monday, and so does the Theatre, the same afternoon. He wanted every leaf of Verona tonight. You said Sunday, after church. He has worn a hole in the king's roll where the crown goes. You told him to con it by the hole.
one_sentence: You carried your own pack the last mile and a half, were given the washing before anyone asked about the road, and told Burbage the orchard is Sunday.
title: Home, and the washing first
